translationRepairs: Hanlin academician Wang Pu, who was expert in calendrical reckoning, received an imperial order to draft a new calendar.
Duanming Hall academician Wang Pu, who was expert in calendrical reckoning, received an imperial order to draft a new calendar.
端明殿學士 is academician of the Duanming Hall, not Hanlin.
Your Majesty examines the calendar and the images of sun, moon, stars, and constellations—the Way of Yao and Tang.
Your Majesty examines the calendar and the images of sun, moon, stars, and constellations—the Way of Tang Yao.
唐堯 is the single sage Yao of Tang, not Yao and Tang.
General-use fraction for solar eclipse timing
Source reads 月食 (lunar eclipse); draft wrongly says solar.
General-use fraction for solar eclipse timing
Source reads 月食 (lunar eclipse); draft wrongly says solar.
He measured the central gnomon at the Imperial Observatory to fix the day-lengths of the solstices, and the clepsydra matched the solar path.
He measured the central gnomon at the Yuetai to fix the day-lengths of the solstices, and the clepsydra matched the solar path.
嶽臺 is the Yuetai gnomon site named earlier, not a generic imperial observatory.
